lines: Even so, that was fine
It was a love that let me think even so was fine
Even knowing there was no going back
I wanted to stay connected
It's the first time I've felt this way
We could only meet now and then
And then not even that
Promises made in words became the norm
But even so, that was fine...
This wish that will never come true
That you'd fall in love with me again
Such a fleeting wish of mine
Today too, I want to see you
Even so, that was fine
It was a love that let me think even so was fine
Before I knew it, you refused
Even to meet
When I'm alone, I end up wondering
Back then, should I
Have just forgotten you?
But these tears are the answer, aren't they?
You can't lie to your heart
I remember it to a frightening degree
Your scent
Your gestures, all of it
It's strange, isn't it?
Say so and laugh at me
We've broken up, yet it's only you on my mind
That love could hurt this much
That love could be this sad
I never thought it
I learned it by truly caring for you
I remember it to a frightening degree
Your scent
Your gestures, all of it
It's strange, isn't it?
Say so and laugh at me
We've broken up, yet it's only you on my mind
You are the one I can't forget
The one I gave everything to
Even if we can never go back
Right now, it's only you...
Only about you
Only you, always
